avoid_supplements.name: D-Cycloserine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both are NMDA receptor antagonists; concurrent use may cause excessive NMDA antagonism leading to cognitive impairment, psychosis, or neurotoxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, obtain specialist approval and monitor closely for adverse CNS effects

avoid_supplements.name: Ketamine supplements/products
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both are NMDA receptor antagonists; additive effects may cause severe CNS depression, dissociation, or psychosis
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not combine under any circumstances

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet effects and could theoretically increase bleeding risk; additive CNS effects possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of bleeding or increased dizziness; generally safe but discuss with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4 and affect memantine metabolism; potential for reduced efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Inform provider before use; monitor memantine efficacy and adjust dosing if needed

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose magnesium may potentiate NMDA antagonism or affect urinary pH and memantine renal clearance
caution_supplements.action: Use normal dietary magnesium; consult provider before high-dose supplementation

caution_foods.name: High-pH foods/alkaline diet
caution_foods.mechanism: Memantine is renally excreted; alkaline urine increases reabsorption, potentially elevating drug levels and risk of toxicity
caution_foods.action: Maintain neutral urine pH; avoid excessive alkaline foods (large amounts of citrus, vegetables); monitor renal function

caution_foods.name: Excessive caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may increase CNS stimulation and potentially exacerbate dizziness, vertigo, or restlessness in sensitive patients
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake; monitor for increased dizziness or agitation

monitoring_notes: Monitor renal function regularly as memantine is primarily renally eliminated; baseline and periodic assessment of cognitive function and neuropsychiatric symptoms is essential. Blood pressure should be monitored as memantine may increase hypertension risk.
